comment: Known high/critical advisories accepted pending a dependency upgrade. Regenerate with: node scripts/audit-gate.mjs --update. Removing an entry does not fix anything - it only stops the build complaining.
reviewNote: prisma 7+, vitest 5 and next 16 are all major upgrades. They are deliberately deferred until the vertical slice is complete, because a major upgrade mid-feature is where integration bugs hide. Revisit before any release.

accepted.reason: Fixed in prisma 7. The project is pinned to prisma 6 per CLAUDE.md §2. 6.19.3 is the newest 6.x.
Transitive of prisma; resolves when prisma moves to 7. Dev-only, never shipped in the runtime image.
Transitive of prisma via @prisma/config. Dev-only, never shipped in the runtime image.
Fixed in vitest 5. Dev-only dependency, never present in a runtime image and never reachable from a deployed service. Deferred alongside the rest of the vitest 5 migration.
Transitive of vitest via vite. Resolves when vitest moves to 5. Dev-only.
Transitive of next 15.5.27. Fixed by next 16, which is a major upgrade carrying App Router migration risk. Highest priority to clear before any release.
